basic_profile.bio: I'm a passionate gamer from Queensland who discovered Reddit about two years ago. My interest in gaming started at a young age, and I've always been drawn to strategy games, especially those with unique mechanics like Pikmin. When I'm not playing games, I enjoy exploring new places around Durban and trying out local cuisines. I work as a software developer, which allows me the flexibility to be online during late evenings and weekends. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time engaging with online communities and learning more about the games I love.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over five years. My interest in gaming has also led me to self-teach various game mechanics and strategies. I enjoy sharing my insights and learning from others on subreddits dedicated to my favorite games.
